title: Bills Ending After the Company Test in a Metering Service Fast-Meter Refund
content:
Whether a **Metering Service** fast-meter refund also covers regular bills of the Electric Service Agreement ending after the company test date depends on whether, and when, the meter was taken out of service.

1. Where the meter was removed from service after the company test date, the fast-meter refund also covers the regular bills whose billing period ended after the company test date and on or before the removal date, added to the bills counted back from the company test date, because the meter kept registering fast until it was taken out.
2. Where the meter is still in service, the fast-meter refund also covers every regular bill whose billing period ended after the company test date, added to the bills counted back.
3. In every other case, a meter removed on or before the company test date among them, no bill whose billing period ended after the company test date is added.

The installation's status and removal date are read from the meter installation record.

## Input, judgement, output (hypothetical, company test on 12 May, bills ending on the last day of each month)

- **Removed 3 July.** Removed after the company test date: the bills ending 31 May and 30 June are added; the bill ending 31 July ended after the removal date and is not.
- **Removed 12 May.** Not removed after the company test date: nothing is added.
- **In service, handling date 20 August.** Every regular bill ending after 12 May is added: those ending 31 May, 30 June and 31 July.
